frozen_policy: These thresholds were committed before any held-out evaluation. Editing them after a held-out run invalidates that run and requires an explicit issue update (replynodes/replynodes-fetcher#487) before the next held-out run. benchmark/thresholds.lock.json records the committed SHA-256.

notes: precision/recall/f1/false_alert_rate/false_negative_rate use the actionable alert decision against the human label.
false_change_rate (price) counts predicted meaningful changes on label-unchanged cases (price false-change gate).
exact_price_accuracy requires amount AND currency AND direction to match the label.
Only a live Jev evaluation can satisfy these gates; deterministic-baseline runs are pipeline evidence.

false_change_rate.description: false-change rate on unchanged price cases
